item.title: Microwave–Matter Interactions in Lithium‐Ion Battery Black Mass: Temperature‐Dependent Dielectric Properties and Carbothermal Reduction Pathways
item.description:
برهم‌کنش مایکروویو با جرم سیاه باتری‌های لیتیوم-یونی LiCoO2 و NMC بررسی شد و افزایش تلفات دی‌الکتریک در ۵۰۰-۶۵۰ درجه سلسیوس با شروع احیای کربوترمی مرتبط است.
Battery Energy | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This study provides rare temperature-dependent dielectric data for real industrial LIB black mass, linking permittivity evolution to carbothermal reduction phases. It reveals that dielectric losses surge during layered-to-oxide transformation (500–650°C), with 910 MHz enabling uniform volumetric heating versus localized 2.45 GHz heating. These insights enable frequency-tuned microwave recycling optimization.
🏷 lithium-ion battery · black mass · microwave heating · dielectric properties · carbothermal reduction

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in identifying cooling-driven oxygen-mediated reconstruction as a key synthetic lever controlling manganese vacancies and stacking faults in sodium manganese oxide cathodes. This challenges prior focus on pre-formed motifs. Its significance: kinetically regulating cooling enables a stacking-fault-rich architecture that suppresses Mn migration and irreversible oxygen release, establishing a general design principle for stabilizing oxygen-redox cathodes.
